title: Absorbing a finding the review itself reported does not re-buy the review it invalidates
body: A gating finding reported by the final review is absorbed and placed before the close-out (whose open-children gate holds it), but the review's already-recorded decision stands, so the fix lands after the review that asserted the items. npq's own words say a fix landing after the review it invalidates is 'appended, not absorbed'. Making the run spend/release the review's recorded decision when it absorbs a review-reported gating finding is a deliberate policy call (releases are today a person's verb) that npq did not make; until then that one case is placement-before-close-out only.
